verses.sloka: इति प्रतिसमादिष्टो हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ।प्रविवेश पुरीं लङ्कां पूज्यमानो निशाचरैः ।। ६.११६.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: iti pratisamādiṣṭo hanumān mārutātmajaḥ ।praviveśa purīṁ laṅkāṁ pūjyamāno niśācaraiḥ ।। 6.116.1 ।।

translations.english: Having been commanded, Hanuman offered prayers to Vibheeshana and entered Lanka.

verses.sloka: प्रविश्य च महातेजा रावणस्य निवेशनम् ।ददर्श मृजया हीनां सातङ्कामिव रोहिणीम् ।वृक्षमूले निरानन्दां राक्षसीभिः समावृताम् ।। ६.११६.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: praviśya ca mahātejā rāvaṇasya niveśanam ।dadarśa mṛjayā hīnāṁ sātaṅkāmiva rohiṇīm ।vṛkṣamūle nirānandāṁ rākṣasībhiḥ samāvṛtām ।। 6.116.2 ।।

translations.english: The monkey, having sought the permission of Vibheeshana, entered Lanka city. Duly entering the Asoka grove, he attracted the attention of Sita, who was weak with no bath, cheerless, seated at the root of the tree, like Rohini star. After reaching the grove, he greeted Sita with folded palms and stood motionless.
translations.hindi: उस समय राक्तसों की सेना ओर वानरों की महती सेना आयुधों को लिए हुए निश्चेष्ट खड़ी थीं

verses.sloka: निभृतः प्रणतः प्रह्वः सो ऽभिगम्याभिवाद्य च ।। ६.११६.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: nibhṛtaḥ praṇataḥ prahvaḥ so 'bhigamyābhivādya ca ।। 6.116.3 ।।

translations.english: The monkey, having sought the permission of Vibheeshana, entered Lanka city. Duly entering the Asoka grove, he attracted the attention of Sita, who was weak with no bath, cheerless, seated at the root of the tree, like Rohini star. After reaching the grove, he greeted Sita with folded palms and stood motionless.
translations.hindi: बलवान श्रीराम और रावण को घोर युद्ध में प्रवृत्त देख; युद्ध देखने में व्यग्र सब लोग विस्मित हो गए

verses.sloka: दृष्ट्वा तमागतं देवी हनुमन्तं महाबलम् ।तूष्णीमास्त तदा दृष्ट्वा स्मृत्वा प्रमुदिता ऽभवत् ।। ६.११६.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tamāgataṁ devī hanumantaṁ mahābalam ।tūṣṇīmāsta tadā dṛṣṭvā smṛtvā pramuditā 'bhavat ।। 6.116.4 ।।

translations.english: The monkey, having sought the permission of Vibheeshana, entered Lanka city. Duly entering the Asoka grove, he attracted the attention of Sita, who was weak with no bath, cheerless, seated at the root of the tree, like Rohini star. After reaching the grove, he greeted Sita with folded palms and stood motionless.
translations.hindi: दोनों ओर की सेनाओं के सेनिक हाथों में विविध प्रकार के आय घो को लिये विस्मित हो, खड़े हुए श्रीराम और रावण का युद्ध देख रहे थे और आपस में एक दूसरे पर प्रहार नहीं करते थे

verses.sloka: सौम्यं दृष्ट्वा मुखं तस्या हनुमान् प्लवगोत्तमः ।रामस्य वचनं सर्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे ।। ६.११६.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: saumyaṁ dṛṣṭvā mukhaṁ tasyā hanumān plavagottamaḥ ।rāmasya vacanaṁ sarvamākhyātumupacakrame ।। 6.116.5 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the mighty Hanuman, who arrived quietly, she was quiet. Then she saw him and experienced joy on recognizing him
translations.hindi: चुस समय रावण को देखते हुए राक्षस ओर श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को. देखते हुए बानर, विस्मित हो, चित्र लिखे से बड़े थे

verses.sloka: वैदेहि कुशली रामः सहसुग्रीवलक्ष्मणः ।विभीषणसहायश्च हरीणां सहितो बलैः ।। ६.११६.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: vaidehi kuśalī rāmaḥ sahasugrīvalakṣmaṇaḥ ।vibhīṣaṇasahāyaśca harīṇāṁ sahito balaiḥ ।। 6.116.6 ।।

translations.english: Gentle Hanuman, the foremost of the monkeys, seeing her started to communicate every word of Rama.
translations.hindi: पूर्वे में देखे हुए शुभ अशुभ शङुनों को श्रीरामचन्द्र और रावण स्मरण कर, निश्चित बुद्धि से खड़े हुए और क्रोध में भरे निर्भीक हो आपस में लड़ रहे थे

verses.sloka: कुशलं चाहु सिद्धार्थो हतशत्रुररिन्दमः ।। ६.११६.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: kuśalaṁ cāhu siddhārtho hataśatrurarindamaḥ ।। 6.116.7 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman said" O Vaidehi! Sri Rama accompanied by Sugriva and Lakshmana, with the help of Vibheeshana, is doing well."
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी--उन दोनों की निश्चितबुद्धि” क्या थी-- से आगे कहते हैं । ] जेतव्यमिति काकुत्स्थो मतव्यमिति रावणः घृतौर स्ववीयसवस्वं युद्धेऽदशेयतां तदा

verses.sloka: विभीषणसहायेन रामेण हरिभिः सह ।निहतो रावणो देवि लक्ष्मणस्य नयेन च ।। ६.११६.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: vibhīṣaṇasahāyena rāmeṇa haribhiḥ saha ।nihato rāvaṇo devi lakṣmaṇasya nayena ca ।। 6.116.8 ।।

translations.english: "Noble lady! Sri Rama killed Ravana and won the enemy. He accomplished the purpose with the help of Vibheeshana, the valiant Lakshmana and the monkeys also so to speak. He inquired of your wellbeing."

verses.sloka: पृष्ट्वा तु कुशलं रामो वीरस्त्वां रघुनन्दनः ।अब्रवीत् परमप्रीतः कृतार्थेनान्तरात्मना ।। ६.११६.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: pṛṣṭvā tu kuśalaṁ rāmo vīrastvāṁ raghunandanaḥ ।abravīt paramaprītaḥ kṛtārthenāntarātmanā ।। 6.116.9 ।।

translations.english: "O noble lady! I am communicating delightful news to you. O Sita, a respectable lady and knowledgeable one, the victory is attained in the combat by the great soul Rama, by virtue of your strength and devotion."

verses.sloka: प्रियमाख्यामि ते देवि त्वां तु भूयः सभाजये ।दिष्ट्या जीवसि धर्मज्ञे जयेन मम संयुगे ।। ६.११६.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: priyamākhyāmi te devi tvāṁ tu bhūyaḥ sabhājaye ।diṣṭyā jīvasi dharmajñe jayena mama saṁyuge ।। 6.116.10 ।।

translations.english: "O noble lady! I am communicating delightful news to you. O Sita, a respectable lady and knowledgeable one, the victory is attained in the combat by the great soul Rama, by virtue of your strength and devotion."

verses.sloka: लब्धो नो विजयः सीते स्वस्था भव गतव्यथा ।रावणश्च हतः शत्रुर्लङ्का चेयं वशे स्थिता ।। ६.११६.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: labdho no vijayaḥ sīte svasthā bhava gatavyathā ।rāvaṇaśca hataḥ śatrurlaṅkā ceyaṁ vaśe sthitā ।। 6.116.11 ।।

translations.english: 'Ravana has been killed, Lanka is under our side vanquished completely. Without any sleep, with forbearance, building an extensive bridge on the great ocean, the vow has been redeemed', is Rama's message to you, said Hanuman.
translations.hindi: ओर रावण के रथ को ध्वजा को लक्ष्य बना, एक पैन] बाण छोड़ा । वह महाविषधर सर्प की तरह असह्य था ओर अपनी दमक से चमक रहा था

verses.sloka: मया ह्यलब्धनिद्रेण दृढेन तव निर्जये ।प्रतिज्ञैषा विनिस्तीर्णा बद्ध्वा सेतुं महोदधौ ।। ६.११६.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: mayā hyalabdhanidreṇa dṛḍhena tava nirjaye ।pratijñaiṣā vinistīrṇā baddhvā setuṁ mahodadhau ।। 6.116.12 ।।

translations.english: "This Lanka is under Vibheeshana, Lord of Lanka. There is no need for perturbation thinking that you are in Ravana's abode."
translations.hindi: लिए का चलन ना ११६६ ` युद्धकाण्डे बह बाण रावण के रथ की ध्वजा को काट कर प्रथिवी में धस गया । रावण के रथ की ध्वजा कट कर भूमि पर गिर 'पड़ी

verses.sloka: सम्भ्रमश्च न गन्तव्यो वर्तन्त्या रावणालये ।विभीषणविधेयं हि लङ्कैश्वर्यमिदं कृतम् ।। ६.११६.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sambhramaśca na gantavyo vartantyā rāvaṇālaye ।vibhīṣaṇavidheyaṁ hi laṅkaiśvaryamidaṁ kṛtam ।। 6.116.13 ।।

translations.english: "You be at ease, as you are living in your own abode", said Hanuman consoling Sita. 'Vibheeshana, who is very happy, is eager and favouring to see you."
translations.hindi: रथ की ध्वजा को कटा हुआ देख, अत्यन्त बलवान्‌ रावण क्रोध से और असहनशीलतावश, अग्नि की तरह भभक उठा

verses.sloka: तदाश्वसिहि विश्वस्ता स्वगृहे परिवर्तसे ।अयं चाभ्येति संहृष्टस्त्वद्दर्शनसमुत्सुकः ।। ६.११६.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadāśvasihi viśvastā svagṛhe parivartase ।ayaṁ cābhyeti saṁhṛṣṭastvaddarśanasamutsukaḥ ।। 6.116.14 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman having spoken in that way, Sita got up in excessive joy and could not speak naturally.
translations.hindi: वह क्रोध के वशवर्ती हो, बहुत से बाणों की वर्षा करने लगा । उसने चमचमाते बाणों से श्रीरामचन्द्र के रथ में जुते हुए घोड़ों को घायल किआ

verses.sloka: एवमुक्ता समुत्पत्य सीता शशिनिभानना ।प्रहर्षेणावरुद्धा सा व्याजहार न किञ्चन ।। ६.११६.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktā samutpatya sītā śaśinibhānanā ।praharṣeṇāvaruddhā sā vyājahāra na kiñcana ।। 6.116.15 ।।

translations.english: Then seeing Sita not answering him, the monkey chief asked her" Why are you not replying. What are you thinking?"
translations.hindi: वे हरे रंग के घोड़े उन बाणों की चोट से न तो भूमि पर गिरे और न भड़के ही। वे स्वस्थ हृदय बने रहे। उन बाणों की चोट उनको ऐसी जान पड़ी मानों कमल की डंडी शारीर में स्पश कर गई हो

verses.sloka: अब्रवीच्च हरिश्रेष्ठः सीतामप्रतिजल्पतीम् ।किं नु चिन्तयसे देवि किं नु मां नाभिभाषसे ।। ६.११६.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: abravīcca hariśreṣṭhaḥ sītāmapratijalpatīm ।kiṁ nu cintayase devi kiṁ nu māṁ nābhibhāṣase ।। 6.116.16 ।।

translations.english: When Hanuman spoke in that way virtuous Sita was overwhelmed with joy and spoke with a voice choked with tears.

verses.sloka: एवमुक्ता हनुमता सीता धर्मे व्यवस्थिता ।अब्रवीत् परमप्रीता हर्षगद्गदया गिरा ।। ६.११६.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktā hanumatā sītā dharme vyavasthitā ।abravīt paramaprītā harṣagadgadayā girā ।। 6.116.17 ।।

translations.english: "No doubt that my husband is victorious is very delightful. Hearing this, I am overcome with delight and am unable to speak for a moment."
translations.hindi: तद्वषेमभवदयुद्ध रनैकशख्रमयं महत्‌ । ' विघुच्य राघवरथं समन्ताद्वानरे बले ॥ १६ उसने उन बाणों के अतिरिक्त गदा, परिघ, चक्र, मूसल, पत्थर, पेड़, शूल, परश्वधादि शस्र की भी वर्षा की । ये सब अख आश्चर्यकर शक्ति से बनाए गए थे। विविध प्रकार के, भय उत्पन्न करने बाले, भयङ्कर और भयानक शब्द करने वाले बहुत से शब्नों की वर्षा हुई । बड़ा घमासान युद्ध हुआ । रावण ने श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के रथ को छोड़, चारों ओर बानरों की सेना के ऊपर

verses.sloka: प्रियमेतदुपश्रुत्य भर्तुर्विजयसंश्रितम् ।प्रहर्षवशमापन्ना निर्वाक्या ऽस्मि क्षणान्तरम् ।। ६.११६.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: priyametadupaśrutya bharturvijayasaṁśritam ।praharṣavaśamāpannā nirvākyā 'smi kṣaṇāntaram ।। 6.116.18 ।।

translations.english: "Hanuman! However, I think to give you a befitting gift for this happy news. I am not able to see any."

verses.sloka: न हि पश्यामि सदृशं चिन्तयन्ती प्लवङ्गम ।मत्प्रियाख्यानाकस्येह तव प्रत्यभिनन्दनम् ।। ६.११६.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: na hi paśyāmi sadṛśaṁ cintayantī plavaṅgama ।matpriyākhyānākasyeha tava pratyabhinandanam ।। 6.116.19 ।।

translations.english: "I am not able to see on this earth, a gift befitting the value of your message, which can be given to you to make you happy."

verses.sloka: न हि पश्यामि तत् सौम्य पृथिव्यामपि वानर ।सदृशं मत्प्रियाख्याने तव दातुं भवेत् समम् ।। ६.११६.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: na hi paśyāmi tat saumya pṛthivyāmapi vānara ।sadṛśaṁ matpriyākhyāne tava dātuṁ bhavet samam ।। 6.116.20 ।।

translations.english: "Neither gold or silver or gems, not even kingdom or the three worlds are equal to what you have spoken now."
translations.hindi: बाणों की वषी कर, आकाश को ऐसा ढको कि, तिल रखने को भी खाली जगह नरह गई । उसने उभड़ते हुए उत्साह १ मायाविहितं --आश्चर्यकरशक्तिक्रतं । (गो) २ तुमुलं--नाना- ` बिध मित्यर्थः । ( गो० ) ३ नैकशास्त्रं-श्रनेकशस्त्रप्रचुर्‌ । (गो०) ४. ज्यायच्छ्मानं--प्रबरतयन्तम्‌ | ( शि० ) ११६८ युद्धकाण्डे से उत्साहित हो हज़ारों बाण, बड़ी सावधानी से छोड़े । युद्ध में प्रवृत्त हो इस प्रकार रावण को तत्परता दिखलाते हुए देख,

verses.sloka: हिरण्यं वा सुवर्णं वा रत्नानि विविधानि च ।राज्यं वा त्रिषु लोकेषु नैतदर्हति भाषितुम् ।। ६.११६.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyaṁ vā suvarṇaṁ vā ratnāni vividhāni ca ।rājyaṁ vā triṣu lokeṣu naitadarhati bhāṣitum ।। 6.116.21 ।।

translations.english: Spoken in that way by Vaidehi, Hanuman stood with folded palms in front of Sita and replied in delight.

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु वैदेह्या प्रत्युवाच प्लवङ्गमः ।गृहीतप्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं सीतायाः प्रमुखे स्थितः ।। ६.११६.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu vaidehyā pratyuvāca plavaṅgamaḥ ।gṛhītaprāñjalirvākyaṁ sītāyāḥ pramukhe sthitaḥ ।। 6.116.22 ।।

translations.english: "You alone can speak such affectionate words in this manner wishing victory and welfare of your dear husband. You are irreproachable."

verses.sloka: भर्तुः प्रियहिते युक्ते भर्तुर्विजयकाङ्क्षिणि ।स्निग्धमेवंविधं वाक्यं त्वमेवार्हसि भाषितुम् ।। ६.११६.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: bhartuḥ priyahite yukte bharturvijayakāṅkṣiṇi ।snigdhamevaṁvidhaṁ vākyaṁ tvamevārhasi bhāṣitum ।। 6.116.23 ।।

translations.english: "O gentle one! Your meaningful words full of affection are more valuable than clusters of gems or Indra, the Lord of gods."

verses.sloka: तवैतद्वचनं सौम्ये सारवत् स्निग्धमेव च ।रत्नौघाद्विविधाच्चापि देवराज्याद्विशिष्यते ।। ६.११६.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tavaitadvacanaṁ saumye sāravat snigdhameva ca ।ratnaughādvividhāccāpi devarājyādviśiṣyate ।। 6.116.24 ।।

translations.english: "Now that the enemy is killed, Rama is happy, which means as if I have attained the rulership of gods."

verses.sloka: अर्थतश्च मया प्राप्ता देवराज्यादयो गुणाः ।हतशत्रुं विजयिनं रामं पश्यामि सुस्थितम् ।। ६.११६.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: arthataśca mayā prāptā devarājyādayo guṇāḥ ।hataśatruṁ vijayinaṁ rāmaṁ paśyāmi susthitam ।। 6.116.25 ।।

translations.english: Hearing the words of Mythili, daughter of Janaka, Hanuman spoke these auspicious words.

verses.sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मैथिली जनकात्मजा ।ततः शुभतरं वाक्यमुवाच पवनात्मजम् ।। ६.११६.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā maithilī janakātmajā ।tataḥ śubhataraṁ vākyamuvāca pavanātmajam ।। 6.116.26 ।।

translations.english: Continuing to pay tribute to Hanuman's words, Sita said" Your language and expression are always richly endowed with virtuous qualities, sweet and valuable, combined with eight excellences. (Eight excellences areKeenness to hear discourses, readiness to hear discourses, receptivity, retentive power, reasoning for a proposition, against a proposition, faculty of comprehension, realization of truth)."
translations.hindi: निरन्तर बाएँ दाहिने ऐसे बाण चले कि, ( उन्होंने आकाशा ढाक दिआ और तब ) ऐसा जान पड़ा , मानो आकाश का स्वाँस लेना ही बंद हो गया

verses.sloka: अतिलक्षणसम्पन्नं माधुर्यगुणभूषितम् ।बुद्ध्या ह्यष्टाङ्गया युक्तं त्वमेवार्हसि भाषितुम् ।। ६.११६.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: atilakṣaṇasampannaṁ mādhuryaguṇabhūṣitam ।buddhyā hyaṣṭāṅgayā yuktaṁ tvamevārhasi bhāṣitum ।। 6.116.27 ।।

translations.english: "You are a praiseworthy son of wind god. In strength, righteousness, valour, vigour, prowess, skill, you are excellent. You are energetic, endowed with tolerance, forbearance, firmness, brilliance, and humility. You alone have many more qualities, no doubt."
translations.hindi: रावण के घोड़ों को श्रीरामचन्द्र जी श्रोर श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के घोड़ों को रावण, घायल करके एक दूसरे से बदला ले रहे थे

verses.sloka: श्लाघनीयो ऽनिलस्य त्वं पुत्रः परमधार्मिकः ।बलं शौर्यं श्रुतं सत्त्वं विक्रमो दाक्ष्यमुत्तमम् ।। ६.११६.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: ślāghanīyo 'nilasya tvaṁ putraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ ।balaṁ śauryaṁ śrutaṁ sattvaṁ vikramo dākṣyamuttamam ।। 6.116.28 ।।

translations.english: "You are a praiseworthy son of wind god. In strength, righteousness, valour, vigour, prowess, skill, you are excellent. You are energetic, endowed with tolerance, forbearance, firmness, brilliance, and humility. You alone have many more qualities, no doubt."
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार उन दोनों महाऋ.द्ध योद्धाओं का बड़ा ही अद्भूत युद्ध हुआ । एक मुहूत्त भर तो ऐसा भयानक युद्ध हुआ कि देखने ` वालों के रोंगटे खड़े हो गए

verses.sloka: तेजः क्षमाधृतिर्धैर्यं विनीतत्वं न संशयः ।एते चान्ये च बहवो गुणास्त्वय्येव शोभनाः ।। ६.११६.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tejaḥ kṣamādhṛtirdhairyaṁ vinītatvaṁ na saṁśayaḥ ।ete cānye ca bahavo guṇāstvayyeva śobhanāḥ ।। 6.116.29 ।।

translations.english: Now with folded palms offering prayers to Sita, Hanuman stood without perturbation, with all humility and again spoke to Sita.

verses.sloka: अथोवाच पुनः सीतामसम्भ्रान्तो विनीतवत् ।प्रगृहीताञ्जलिर्हर्षात् सीतायाः प्रमुखे स्थितः ।। ६.११६.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: athovāca punaḥ sītāmasambhrānto vinītavat ।pragṛhītāñjalirharṣāt sītāyāḥ pramukhe sthitaḥ ।। 6.116.30 ।।

translations.english: "I desire to kill all those Rakshasas who in the past have intimidated you indeed and whoever threatened you."

verses.sloka: इमास्तु खलु राक्षस्यो यदि त्वमनुमन्यसे ।हन्तुमिच्छाम्यहं सर्वा याभिस्त्वं तर्जिता पुरा ।। ६.११६.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: imāstu khalu rākṣasyo yadi tvamanumanyase ।hantumicchāmyahaṁ sarvā yābhistvaṁ tarjitā purā ।। 6.116.31 ।।

translations.english: "O Devi! You, who were so devoted to your husband, were tormented in Asoka grove earlier. These cruel Rakshasas of hideous conduct, of fierce and distorted forms with terrible eyes addressing you in harsh words by Ravana's order, were heard by me."

verses.sloka: क्लिश्यन्तीं पतिदेवां त्वामशोकवनिकां गताम् ।। ६.११६.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: kliśyantīṁ patidevāṁ tvāmaśokavanikāṁ gatām ।। 6.116.32 ।।

translations.english: "O Devi! You, who were so devoted to your husband, were tormented in Asoka grove earlier. These cruel Rakshasas of hideous conduct, of fierce and distorted forms with terrible eyes addressing you in harsh words by Ravana's order, were heard by me."

verses.sloka: घोररूपसमाचाराः क्रूराः क्रूरतरेक्षणाः ।राक्षस्यो दारुणकथा वरमेतत् प्रयच्छ मे ।। ६.११६.३३ ।।मुष्टिभिः पाणिभिः सर्वाश्चरणैश्चैव शोभने ।इच्छामि विविधैर्घातैर्हन्तुमेताः सुदारुणाः ।। ६.११६.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ghorarūpasamācārāḥ krūrāḥ krūratarekṣaṇāḥ ।rākṣasyo dāruṇakathā varametat prayaccha me ।। 6.116.33 ।।muṣṭibhiḥ pāṇibhiḥ sarvāścaraṇaiścaiva śobhane ।icchāmi vividhairghātairhantumetāḥ sudāruṇāḥ ।। 6.116.34 ।।

translations.english: "I wish to kill by all kinds of strokes, these cruel distorted forms of Rakshasas having terrible hair and fierce eyes and not to mention their violence. Permit me."

verses.sloka: घातैर्जानुप्रहारैश्च दशनानां च पातनैः ।भक्षणैः कर्णनासानां केशानां लुञ्चनैस्तथा ।। ६.११६.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: ghātairjānuprahāraiśca daśanānāṁ ca pātanaiḥ ।bhakṣaṇaiḥ karṇanāsānāṁ keśānāṁ luñcanaistathā ।। 6.116.35 ।।

translations.english: "I wish to kill by all kinds of strokes, these cruel distorted forms of Rakshasas having terrible hair and fierce eyes and not to mention their violence. Permit me."

verses.sloka: नखैः शुष्कमुखीभिश्च दारणैर्लङ्घनैर्हतैः ।निपात्य हन्तुमिच्छामि तव विप्रियकारिणीः ।। ६.११६.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: nakhaiḥ śuṣkamukhībhiśca dāraṇairlaṅghanairhataiḥ ।nipātya hantumicchāmi tava vipriyakāriṇīḥ ।। 6.116.36 ।।

translations.english: "These Rakshasas who have wronged, who are of dreadful appearance, I wish to hit them with fists, with feet spreading long arms, strike with blows of shanks and knees, with teeth, and torment by pulling their ears and nose. Their hair will be torn off violently, their faces will be made dry, they will be tossed up, torn with different sharp conches. Their broken bodies, heads, necks, and trunks will be thrown down and killed. Grant this boon to me."

verses.sloka: एवंप्रकारैर्बहुभिर्विप्रकारैर्यशस्विनि ।हन्तुमिच्छाम्यहं देवि तवेमाः कृतकिल्बिषाः ।। ६.११६.३७ ।।
verses.transliteration: evaṁprakārairbahubhirviprakārairyaśasvini ।hantumicchāmyahaṁ devi tavemāḥ kṛtakilbiṣāḥ ।। 6.116.37 ।।

translations.english: "These Rakshasas who have wronged, who are of dreadful appearance, I wish to hit them with fists, with feet spreading long arms, strike with blows of shanks and knees, with teeth, and torment by pulling their ears and nose. Their hair will be torn off violently, their faces will be made dry, they will be tossed up, torn with different sharp conches. Their broken bodies, heads, necks, and trunks will be thrown down and killed. Grant this boon to me."

verses.sloka: एवमुक्ता हनुमता वैदेही जनकात्मजा ।उवाच धर्मसहितं हनुमन्तं यशस्विनी ।। ६.११६.३८ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktā hanumatā vaidehī janakātmajā ।uvāca dharmasahitaṁ hanumantaṁ yaśasvinī ।। 6.116.38 ।।

translations.english: "These Rakshasas who have wronged, who are of dreadful appearance, I wish to hit them with fists, with feet spreading long arms, strike with blows of shanks and knees, with teeth, and torment by pulling their ears and nose. Their hair will be torn off violently, their faces will be made dry, they will be tossed up, torn with different sharp conches. Their broken bodies, heads, necks, and trunks will be thrown down and killed. Grant this boon to me."

verses.sloka: राजसंश्रयवश्यानां कुर्वन्तीनां पराज्ञया ।विधेयानां च दासीनां कः कुप्येद्वानरोत्तम ।। ६.११६.३९ ।।
verses.transliteration: rājasaṁśrayavaśyānāṁ kurvantīnāṁ parājñayā ।vidheyānāṁ ca dāsīnāṁ kaḥ kupyedvānarottama ।। 6.116.39 ।।

translations.english: "O Illustrious lady! I would like to kill the terrible forms of ogres who threatened you, in that way, I will be at and strike in many ways and destroy them", said Hanuman to Sita.

verses.sloka: भाग्यवैषम्ययोगेन पुरादुश्चरितेन च ।मयैतत् प्राप्यते सर्वं स्वकृतं ह्युपभुज्यते ।। ६.११६.४० ।।
verses.transliteration: bhāgyavaiṣamyayogena purāduścaritena ca ।mayaitat prāpyate sarvaṁ svakṛtaṁ hyupabhujyate ।। 6.116.40 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman having spoken like that, Sita who was fond of the desperate, thus spoke to Hanuman thinking for a while.

verses.sloka: प्राप्तव्यं तु दशायोगान्मयैतदिति निश्चितम् ।दासीनां रावणस्याहं मर्षयामीह दुर्बला ।। ६.११६.४१ ।।
verses.transliteration: prāptavyaṁ tu daśāyogānmayaitaditi niścitam ।dāsīnāṁ rāvaṇasyāhaṁ marṣayāmīha durbalā ।। 6.116.41 ।।

translations.english: "Foremost of Vanaras! Who will be angry? Being under the command of the king and being obedient maids, they did so according to king's order.

verses.sloka: आज्ञप्ता रावणेनैता राक्षस्यो मामतर्जयन् ।हते तस्मिन्न कुर्युर्हि तर्जनं वानरोत्तम ।। ६.११६.४२ ।।
verses.transliteration: ājñaptā rāvaṇenaitā rākṣasyo māmatarjayan ।hate tasminna kuryurhi tarjanaṁ vānarottama ।। 6.116.42 ।।

translations.english: Through the adverse working of my fate and my own former misdeeds all this has befallen me; one must indeed experience the fruit of one's own deeds.

verses.sloka: अयं व्याघ्रसमीपे तु पुराणो धर्मसंस्थितः ।ऋक्षेण गीतः श्लोको मे तन्निबोध प्लवङ्गम ।। ६.११६.४३ ।।
verses.transliteration: ayaṁ vyāghrasamīpe tu purāṇo dharmasaṁsthitaḥ ।ṛkṣeṇa gītaḥ śloko me tannibodha plavaṅgama ।। 6.116.43 ।।

translations.english: "Mighty Armed Hanuman! Do not speak in this manner. It was my fate which was supreme. Because of my predetermined circumstances I reaped such a result. I am feeblehearted and condone the maids surely."

verses.sloka: न परः पापमादत्ते परेषां पापकर्मणाम् ।समयो रक्षितव्यस्तु सन्तश्चारित्रभूषणाः ।। ६.११६.४४ ।।
verses.transliteration: na paraḥ pāpamādatte pareṣāṁ pāpakarmaṇām ।samayo rakṣitavyastu santaścāritrabhūṣaṇāḥ ।। 6.116.44 ।।

translations.english: "By Ravana's order they threatened me so. Now with his death, they will not be threatening me."

verses.sloka: पापानां वा शुभानां वा वधार्हाणां प्लवङ्गम ।कार्यं करुणमार्येण न कश्चिन्नापराध्यति ।। ६.११६.४५ ।।
verses.transliteration: pāpānāṁ vā śubhānāṁ vā vadhārhāṇāṁ plavaṅgama ।kāryaṁ karuṇamāryeṇa na kaścinnāparādhyati ।। 6.116.45 ।।

translations.english: "O Monkey! In olden days a bear had uttered a verse which conforms to righteousness. I shall tell you now."

verses.sloka: लोकहिंसाविहाराणां रक्षसां कामरूपिणाम् ।कुर्वतामपि पापानि नैव कार्यमशोभनम् ।। ६.११६.४६ ।।
verses.transliteration: lokahiṁsāvihārāṇāṁ rakṣasāṁ kāmarūpiṇām ।kurvatāmapi pāpāni naiva kāryamaśobhanam ।। 6.116.46 ।।

translations.english: A wise man does not take upon himself the offence of others' sinful deeds; when the occasion arises one's pledge must be guarded, for the virtuous ever wear good conduct as their ornament.

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु हनुमान् सीतया वाक्यकोविदः ।प्रत्युवाच ततः सीतां रामपत्नीं यशस्विनीम् ।। ६.११६.४७ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu hanumān sītayā vākyakovidaḥ ।pratyuvāca tataḥ sītāṁ rāmapatnīṁ yaśasvinīm ।। 6.116.47 ।।

translations.english: "Sinners or noble men, having done a wrong deed and deserve death. Also noble, will show compassion and not commit harm."

verses.sloka: युक्ता रामस्य भवती धर्मपत्नी यशस्विनी ।प्रतिसन्दिश मां देवि गमिष्ये यत्र राघवः ।। ६.११६.४८ ।।
verses.transliteration: yuktā rāmasya bhavatī dharmapatnī yaśasvinī ।pratisandiśa māṁ devi gamiṣye yatra rāghavaḥ ।। 6.116.48 ।।

translations.english: "Rakshasas by nature are cruel in their deeds and can assume any form according to their will. No sinful actions to be done even if they do sinful actions."

verses.sloka: एवमुक्ता हनुमता वैदेही जनकात्मजा ।अब्रवीद्द्रष्टुमिच्छामि भर्तारं वानरोत्तम ।। ६.११६.४९ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktā hanumatā vaidehī janakātmajā ।abravīddraṣṭumicchāmi bhartāraṁ vānarottama ।। 6.116.49 ।।

translations.english: Sita, having spoken that way to Hanuman, he, who was capable of good expression, replied as follows to Rama's consort, who was irreproachable.

verses.sloka: तस्यास्तद्वनं श्रुत्वा हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ।हर्षयन् मैथिलीं वाक्यमुवाचेदं महाद्युतिः ।। ६.११६.५० ।।
verses.transliteration: tasyāstadvanaṁ śrutvā hanumān mārutātmajaḥ ।harṣayan maithilīṁ vākyamuvācedaṁ mahādyutiḥ ।। 6.116.50 ।।

translations.english: "Devi! you are the righteous wife of Rama and earned fame. Give me the right message to Rama in return. I will go."

verses.sloka: पूर्णचन्द्राननं रामं द्रक्ष्यस्यार्ये सलक्ष्मणम् ।स्थिरमित्रं हतामित्रं शचीव त्रिदशेश्वरम् ।। ६.११६.५१ ।।
verses.transliteration: pūrṇacandrānanaṁ rāmaṁ drakṣyasyārye salakṣmaṇam ।sthiramitraṁ hatāmitraṁ śacīva tridaśeśvaram ।। 6.116.51 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman, having spoken that way to Vaidehi, daughter of Janaka, she said" I desire to see my husband."

verses.sloka: तामेवमुक्त्वा राजन्तीं सीतां साक्षादिव श्रियम् ।आजगाम महावेगो हनुमान् यत्र राघवः ।। ६.११६.५२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāmevamuktvā rājantīṁ sītāṁ sākṣādiva śriyam ।ājagāma mahāvego hanumān yatra rāghavaḥ ।। 6.116.52 ।।

translations.english: On hearing Mythili, wise Hanuman spoke these words to her bringing joy to her.

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे षोडशोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। ११६ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe ṣoḍaśottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 116 ।।

translations.english: "Now you will see Sri Rama whose countenance resembles the moon, with Lakshmana, with friends who are alive, with friends whose enemies are gone, just as Sachi, the consort of Indra, the Lord of gods saw."
